$comment: Editor dependency boundaries (ARQ Interaction Foundation 1.0, docs 04-DEPENDENCY-POLICY). Rule-driven so future boundaries (renderer, server-only, package ownership) extend this file instead of forking the checker. Scopes are path prefixes relative to the repository root; a file matches the FIRST scope that contains it. 'forbiddenPackages' fails on both source imports (import/require/dynamic import) and package.json dependency declarations within the scope.

rules.reason: Lenis-style scroll smoothing corrupts exact wheel zoom, trackpad pan and numeric-entry surfaces. Allowed only on public marketing/documentation sites, never in the product.
React Aria is ARQ's accessibility foundation. A second dialog/menu/focus system means two competing focus managers and double semantics.
Out of scope for the interaction foundation by decision record D2/D7 and the implementation contract: no second state architecture, no second animation system, no renderer rewrite without evidence.
